Oliver: Heads-up — preparing RC candidate rc-2026-03-22-1. Target promote window 18:30 PT. Need signoffs + docs finalization by 17:45 PT. Pinning build-20260322.1 for the candidate.

Maya: running smoke now (kv warm + simple regen checks). will post results in ~10m.

deploybot: INFO: pinning artifact -> build-20260322.1 to rc-2026-03-22-1
deploybot: INFO: starting smoke pipeline smoke/rc-2026-03-22-1 (jobs: kv-warm, basic-e2e, latency-probe)

Maya: smoke OK. kv-warm looked good, basic-e2e green. latency probe: p95 ~320ms, p99 ~680ms for a 5m window (burst from warmup). No errors.

Sam: quick docs note — release notes need a tiny erratum for embeddings API default batch size change (I missed this in the draft). Commit is 0a1b2c3. Can we append: "Fixed default embeddings batch_size backcompat note"?

Anya: infra LGTM. autoscaler check passed. I ran the safety-runner: capacity headroom >= 30% on us-west1.

Oliver: thanks. Rollback criteria we agreed on yesterday: error-rate spike >5% for 3m OR sustained p95 >600ms for 5m -> abort and roll back. Also manual abort if corepath errors land in >2% of unique request IDs.

Maya: adding a quick smoke test to the release notes section with a pointer to the smoke logs: https://logs.internal/smoke/rc-2026-03-22-1

Sam: docs erratum appended and pushed to release-notes/rc-2026-03-22-1.md (PR #421). Maya can you eyeball?

Maya: looked. tiny grammar tweak but fine to ship.

sheriff-bot: @oncall notified for promotion window 18:30 PT -> alert channel engaged (ruleset: rc-promote-default).

Oliver: final checklist before promote: 1) artifact pinned (deploybot) 2) smoke green (Maya) 3) docs PR merged (Sam) 4) infra + rollback rules set (Anya) 5) oncall aware (sheriff-bot). Confirm with +1.

Maya: +1
Sam: +1 (docs merged)
Anya: +1
Oliver: OK prepping promote. Triggering the deploybot promote command in 2m. If anyone needs to halt, say "hold" now.

deploybot: Running promote command:
```
/deploy promote --rc=rc-2026-03-22-1 --artifact=build-20260322.1 --target=prod --staged=auto --max-traffic-step=25
```

deploybot: INFO: starting staged rollout (steps: 25%, 50%, 100%)
deploybot: INFO: step1 -> 25% traffic routed to rc-2026-03-22-1 (health check window 2m)

Maya: watching metrics. step1 p95=340ms, errors=0.02% -> proceed.

deploybot: step2 -> 50% traffic. health ok.

Anya: infra metrics normal; nothing anomalous on ingress or redis heat.
deploybot: step3 -> shifting to 100% traffic now.

deploybot: SUCCESS: rc-2026-03-22-1 promoted to prod. All traffic routed. Promotion duration: 6m 12s.

Oliver: nice. I'll update the release notes with final timestamps and the small docs erratum. Thanks all. If any regressions crop up, follow rollback playbook: https://internal/playbooks/rc-rollback (priority execs: Maya & Anya).

Sam: added final timestamp and a note about the embeddings default fix. Pushed release notes final.

Maya: monitoring for 30m post-promo, will shout if anything > threshold.

deploybot: NOTE: audit entry created -> deploy:rc-2026-03-22-1 user:oliver duration:372s artifacts:[build-20260322.1]

Oliver: closing thread. Great job :tada:
